posts.text: tThe Democrats social media account posted insulting language towards Stephen Miller, and the Republican Party and conservative voters reacted in indignation.  But the Democrats post was in response to Stephen Miller’s offensive post against James Talarico and came after endless offensive  attacks by the right, including the president.

Vulcan Elements, a small startup out of North Carolina tied to Donald Trump Jr. received a $620 million Pentagon loan after a request came directly for President Trump’s advisor, Peter Navarro.  The loan was also processed much faster than any other loan.

Is the Strait of Hormuz in international waters? President Donald Trump said that the Strait of Hormuz is in “international Waters“ and Iran and Oman do not control it.  But international law says otherwise. According to international law, the Strait of Hormuz is an international strait, which is different from international Waters.

Stephen Miller, the advisor to President Trump, published a post on social media to discuss Texas democratic US Senate candidate @James Talarico and used a word Miller clearly considers offensive but only shows Miller’s intolerance #stephenmiller #tolerance #talarico

Equality vs. Equity. We need to support Black owned businesses, and a Black Entertainment Network, and a Black Hsitory month, because we need to inject equity in the American system.  Black American have been underrepresented and underserved, and equity provides them with the tools society has denied them.  Responding to @@tenin.abt  #equality #blackownedsmallbusiness #socialjustice

A video is circulating of a woman wearing a hijab appearing at a Memorial Day parade.  The woman is Amira Hashwi, an American attorney and Wayne County pageant winner from Dearborn Michigan, who, as is tradition, took part in the Dearborn Memorial Day parade.  But people like @IMRIGHTINFRONT2 take exception to that.

During a diplomatic trip to India, Secretary of State Marco Rubio held a press conference, where he inadvertently called President Trump “stupid”. Rubio was asked about offensive comments made in the United States about India and replied that every country has stupid people who make dumb comments online. Rubio didn’t know that the journalist who asked the question was referring to a comment made by President Donald Trump about India, calling it  a “hell hole“

People think that white privilege does not affect them just because they work hard every day, and don’t understand how much Black Americans are forced to struggle just to reach equality.  They don’t understand that inequality is embedded in the American society.  Let’s fact check @almostmakingit616 #whiteprivilege #racialequality

During his commencement speech to West Point’s graduating class, Secretary of defense, Pete Hegseth said that “diversity is our strength“ is the single dumbest phrase in military history, because “unity“ is the strength of the military. Hegseth does not understand that unity and diversity can coexist and are both important in the US military  #petehegseth #diversity #usmilitary #westpoint

Republican house members delayed  a war Powers resolution vote that would’ve limited Trump‘s ability to continue the war in Iran, causing Congress to leave Washington for the memorial day weekend without a vote.  #iranwar #uscongress
